title: Exponential quantum advantage in processing massive classical data
abstract: arXiv:2604.07639v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Broadly applicable quantum advantage, particularly in classical data processing and machine learning, has been a fundamental open problem. In this work, we prove that a small quantum computer of polylogarithmic size can perform large-scale classification and dimension reduction on massive classical data by processing samples on the fly, whereas any classical machine achieving the same prediction performance requires exponentially larger size. Furthermore, classical machines that are exponentially larger yet below the required size need superpolynomially more samples and time. We provide evidence for these quantum advantages in real-world applications, including single-cell RNA sequencing and movie review sentiment analysis, demonstrating four to six orders of magnitude reduction in size with fewer than 60 logical qubits. translated_title: 处理海量经典数据的指数级量子优势
translated_abstract: 广泛适用的量子优势，特别是在经典数据处理和机器学习领域，一直是一个基础性的开放问题。在这项工作中，我们证明了一个多对数规模的小型量子计算机可以通过即时处理样本的方式，对海量经典数据执行大规模分类和降维任务，而任何实现相同预测性能的经典机器都需要指数级更大的规模。此外，那些规模虽呈指数级增大但仍低于所需规模的经典机器，则需要超多项式级别的更多样本和时间。我们在实际应用中为这些量子优势提供了证据，包括单细胞RNA测序和电影评论情感分析，展示了仅需不到60个逻辑量子比特即可实现规模上四到六个数量级的缩减。这些量子优势由量子预言机草图技术实现，这是一种用于访问经典数据的算法。
tldr: 本文证明了多对数规模的小型量子计算机通过量子预言机草图技术，可在海量经典数据的分类与降维任务中实现指数级优势，并在单细胞RNA测序和情感分析等实际应用中以不到60个逻辑量子比特展示了四到六个数量级的规模缩减。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that a polylogarithmic-sized quantum computer, enabled by quantum oracle sketching, achieves an exponential quantum advantage in large-scale classification and dimension reduction of massive classical data, demonstrated in real-world applications such as single-cell RNA sequencing and sentiment analysis with fewer than 60 logical qubits.
